mapping_process:
Glacier outlines were derived for Juvfonne and surrounding glaciers using manual digitisation from orthophotos or from measuring the extent by foot using GNSS-Global Navigation Satellite System. See Andreassen et al. (2026) for details on data collection and results.

Explanation of attribute fields, I have used main GLIMS attribute fields (can be in different order in the various files):

-----------------
BreID                   local glacier ID for Norway from the two lates inventories (Andreassen et al. 2012; 2022)
WGMSid                           id of WGMS
Name                 glacier name
acq_time          Time of image acquisition, dd.mm.yyyy, e.g. 25.08.2010
loc_unc_x        m “Local” positional uncertainty in X of vertex positions (for GLIMS submission)
loc_unc_y         m “Local” positional uncertainty in Y of vertex positions (for GLIMS submission)
glob_unc_x     m “Global” positional uncertainty in X of vertex positions; basically geolocation uncertainty (for GLIMS submission)
glob_unc_y     m “Global” positional uncertainty in Y of vertex positions; basically geolocation uncertainty (for GLIMS submission)
inst_name       image Source, e.g. orthophoto, GNSS (measured by foot using GNSS)
Data_owner    data owner, e.g. NVE - Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate
Comment                        comment, e.g if only part was measured
PROC_DESC  description of processing, e.g. manual digitisation
